name: Administrator signs in with valid credentials
expected: Redirected to the Administrator Dashboard

name: Sign-in with a wrong password
expected: Access denied; error message shown; stays on the sign-in page
actual: Stayed on /login; message: "Invalid username or password."

name: Opening an admin page without signing in
expected: Redirected to the sign-in page

name: Teacher account opens an administrator page
expected: Access refused (role-based access control)

name: Successful sign-in is recorded
expected: New login_history row (success) and an active user_sessions row

name: Five wrong passwords lock the account
expected: users.locked_until set ~15 min ahead; the correct password is then refused
actual: locked_until = now + 14 min; correct password refused

name: Signing out ends the session
expected: user_sessions row gets terminated_at; protected pages redirect to sign-in

name: Add Student form saves a new student
expected: New row in students table with the entered details

name: Dashboard figures match the database
expected: Students and Teachers counts on the dashboard equal the database counts
actual: Students UI 147 / DB 147; Teachers UI 7 / DB 7 (page http://127.0.0.1:8081/admin)

name: Request without a signature
expected: Refused with HTTP 401; nothing recorded

name: Request with a tampered signature
expected: Refused (SIGNATURE_INVALID)

name: Terminal heartbeat
expected: Accepted; devices.last_heartbeat_at and a device_heartbeats row written
actual: HTTP 200; heartbeat rows +1; last heartbeat 0s ago

name: Student taps before the teacher opens the session
expected: Refused (SESSION_NOT_OPEN); no attendance row

name: Teacher fingerprint opens the scheduled class
expected: Session opened in attendance_sessions for the scheduled subject/section/room
actual: HTTP 201 SESSION_OPENED; ATT-2026-000101 | status open | roster 32

name: Student RFID tap after the session opens
expected: Time-in recorded in attendance_records with status
actual: HTTP 201: "Time in recorded for Ocampo, Pedro."; DB time_in 13:13:43 | late

name: Same tap re-sent (network retry)
expected: Accepted as a duplicate; still exactly one attendance row

name: Card of a student from another section
expected: Refused; not recorded in this class

name: Replayed request (same nonce reused)
expected: Second copy refused as a replay

name: Tap appears on the teacher dashboard
expected: Teacher sees the open session and the tapped student
actual: "Session open" shown: true; Ocampo listed: true

name: Class closed early, reopened by fingerprint, absent student taps
expected: Session reopens; the student marked Absent at close is recorded as present/late
actual: close HTTP 200 → student Absent; reopen HTTP 201 SESSION_OPENED; tap HTTP 201 → Late at 13:13:45

name: Teacher opens the class by password (fingerprint failover)
expected: Session opened by password; admin dashboard shows the override count and a Needs-attention entry
actual: HTTP 200; opened_method=password; tile shows 1 override(s); Needs-attention entry: true

name: Daily Attendance report returns the stored records
expected: Report row count equals attendance records in the database for the day

name: Export the report as PDF and Excel and save it
expected: Valid PDF and XLSX files downloaded; generated_reports row saved
